description: This module replaces the default image-based product section in the Odoo POS interface with a structured product list view, allowing faster browsing and easier product selection.
summary: The POS Product List View module enhances the Odoo Point of Sale interface by replacing the traditional image-based product grid with a streamlined list view. Instead of displaying large product tiles with images, this module presents items in a structured text-based list, showing product names and prices in a compact layout. This approach significantly improves usability for businesses that manage large product catalogs or do not rely heavily on product images. Cashiers and sales staff can easily scroll through products, search faster, and select items more efficiently. name: POS Global Suggested Product
description: The Global Product Suggestions feature for the Point of Sale system empowers businesses to increase sales by displaying a curated list of suggested products during the checkout process. These products are strategically selected and shown on the payment screen, allowing sales associates to offer additional items to customers as they complete their purchase.
summary: The Global Product Suggestions feature for the Point of Sale system is designed to enhance the sales process by strategically displaying a curated list of recommended products to customers during checkout. These suggestions are tailored to encourage sales associates to offer complementary or additional items, increasing the likelihood of upselling or cross-selling. By incorporating these suggested products on the POS payment screen, businesses can enhance the customer experience by making relevant recommendations in real time. This feature is especially valuable in retail environments, restaurants, and service industries where customers may be interested in adding related items or services. As a result, businesses can increase their average order value, streamline the purchasing process, and ultimately drive more sales while providing a more personalized shopping experience. name: Product Variant Description
description:
The Product Variant Description Manager module allows users to view key descriptions for product variants across different modules in Odoo. This ensures easy access to essential information, enhancing clarity for product handling and supporting improved decision-making throughout sales, purchases, and inventory management.

        Key Features:
        1) Sales Description Access:
           - View the sales description directly within the product variant form.

        2) Purchase Description Access:
           - Access the purchase description within the product variant form.

        3) Inventory Description Access:
           - Check the inventory description of the product variant in the product variant form.

        4) Sales Order Integration:
           - Display the sales description in the sales order lines for clarity.

        5) Purchase Order Integration:
           - Show the purchase description in the purchase order lines.

        6) Delivery Order Integration:
           - View the inventory description in the delivery order lines for better tracking.

description:

        1) Vendor Product Codes in PO and RFQ Lines:

        2) Automatic Product Code Update:

        3) Include Product Codes in Reports:
           - Adds the vendor product code to the printed PO and RFQ reports, streamlining documentation.
